correctness.rationale: The independent-cascade live-edge formulation on a path gives each exterior vertex probability p^j and each interior vertex p^j+p^(b-j)-p^b (two disjoint routes); summation proves the stated influence polynomial for every n>=2 and 0<p<1. Exchanging one tail vertex strictly improves an unbalanced split, yielding the only optimum at each gap. The exact adjacent-gap increment is p^b[1+b(1-p)]-p^ceil((n-1-b)/2). The ratio R_(b+1)/R_b is at most p(2-p)<1, proving strict unimodality over all integer gaps; g_b=(b-h_b)log p+log[1+b(1-p)] is strictly concave, negative near zero and positive immediately left of one, so its unique interior zero yields precisely one threshold for b>=ceil((n+1)/3). Their strict ordering and n=4 p=1/2 follow. Checked direct independent exact adjacent differences and tail balancing in 140 cases; finite checks do not justify universal quantifiers.
